liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd72-04-07.aud.sirmick.31329.sbeok.flacf** (recommended): audience recording; 26 songs; 181 min; rated 1.29/5 by 7 [1]. Said about its sound: One of the two audience masters has about average sound quality; the other is described as worse; Reviewer calls it the worst recording they have heard; advises waiting for a better source; The audience copy is muddy but listenable, and fills the gaps around the board releases [1][11][12]
- **gd72-04-07.aud.hanno.6161.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 23 songs; 181 min; rated 2.36/5 by 22 [2]. Said about its sound: Considered possibly the poorest-sounding Dead recording in circulation; the better of two audience sources is still horrendous; Very poor audience tape that needs heavy equalization to be tolerable; Sounds as if the recorder was left running far from the stage, near the taper's car [3][5][6][7][8][10][13]

## Around the show

- Sam Cutler gave an introduction before the band opened with Greatest Story Ever Told [1]
- Europe '72 tour shows had a rare quality, so the reviewer wants every one, despite this tape [5]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd72-04-07.aud.sirmick.31329.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by SIRMick; source: Audience: Unknown Mics (remaster) [1]. Also: This is a remaster of shnid 6161, put together from two audience master recordings [1]
- **gd72-04-07.aud.hanno.6161.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience: Unknown Mics [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Newbury Comics: [Wembley Empire Pool, London, England 4/7/1972 Live 5LP Box Set](https://www.newburycomics.com/products/grateful_dead-wembley_empire_pool-_london-_england_4-7-1972_live_5lp_box_set) [16]
- Fan art by Musical Paradise | CD | DVD | GAMES | BOOKS | ELECTRONICS | MERCHANDISE | CONSOLES: [GRATEFUL DEAD - LIVE AT WEMBLEY EMPIRE POOL LONDON (4/7/72) (5LP LIMITED EDITION VINYL) RSD '22 - Musical Paradise | CD ](https://musicalparadise.com/product/grateful-dead-live-at-wembley-empire-pool-london-4-7-72-5lp-limited-edition-vinyl-rsd-22/) [17]
- Fan art by Bundle Music: [Grateful Dead - History Of The Grateful Dead Vol. 1 &](https://bundlemusic.com/products/history-of-the-grateful-dead-vol-1-wembley-empire-pool-london-england-4-7-1972-live-5lp-180g) [18]
- Photo by Caine Schneider (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - 4/7/72 Wembley Empire Pool, London, England](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/26793055831/) [19]
